name: SM_Arch_Stone_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: freestanding sandstone archway, 2.3 m wide and 3.4 m tall: plinths, two piers of six courses, imposts, a round arch of eleven voussoirs with a proud keystone
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: Every stone is a bevelled block of 12 triangles in the game mesh: joints are real gaps, arrises are in the normal map only. No mortar, and all blocks of a course are one stone deep. One convex hull is exported, which blocks the opening: a walk-through arch needs two pier hulls and a lintel hull, a level decision. Stone is one tinted rock scan with procedural moss and lichen; carving detail comes from displacement, not from modelled tool work.
